9EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAWN
Grey light. The bus idles in its bay, engine coughing.
EXTD3/81, 2Rayapuram Bus Stand
10INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - DAY
The bus rattles through paddy fields. Every window is open. A goat stands in the aisle, its owner asleep.
INTD5/81, 2Farooq's Bus - Moving
11EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY
A straight road between casuarina trees. The wind pushes the trees all one way.
EXTD2/81, 2Coastal Highway
12EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST - DAY
The tower still stands. The equipment is half dead. The storm is coming faster than the forecast.
